01 · Your inspiration

Your moodboards

The four boards from Visual refferences/. They read as one Neptunian / Pisces vibe at two saturations — a vivid iridescent dream (boards 1–3) and a muted warm dream (board 4).

The vibe, in words

  • Neptunian / Pisces spine: illusory, dreamy, translucent, "between dream and waking, from another dimension."
  • Language: iridescence (oil-on-water), frosted glass, aura glow, mist & cloud, watercolor bleed, soft focus, no hard edges.
  • Warm & luminous — deliberately not dark purple-cosmic, not cold grayscale SaaS.
  • Full analysis: concept/moodboard-analysis.md
02 · The benchmark

CHANI teardown

16 screenshots sliced from your screen recording — the full flow, signup → chart → paid content. CHANI turned out warmer and more playful than its reputation: hand-made zine mysticism.

What to borrow

  • Three-voice type: expressive serif display + warm humanist sans body + monospace uppercase labels.
  • Squiggle dividers under titles — cheap, ownable "handmade" warmth.
  • Warm off-white + one accent, no purple. Reading blocks: mono eyebrow → squiggle → sans body.
  • Full profile: research/mobbin-visual-research.md · screenshots in research/screens/chani/
03 · The field

Competitor visual research

Palette, typography and mood pulled from real screens on Mobbin. The category splits into cold editorial (Co-Star), purple cosmic (Moonly — the trap), and warm document (Tolan, Calm — closest to us).

Cold editorial

Co-Star

Serif + monospace on bone paper, zero colour. Steal the structure, reject the chill.

Mobbin ↗ Purple cosmic · avoid

Moonly

Serif on indigo starfield, glossy 3D planets. The templated look to escape.

Mobbin ↗ Warm document · best

Tolan

Warm-paper report grammar: eyebrow → title → paragraph → hairline. $50-keepsake feel.

Mobbin ↗ Warm & luminous

Calm

Photographic hero sets the palette, chrome recedes. Warmth from the picture layer.

Mobbin ↗ Chart rendering

Co-Star wheel

Thin line-art zodiac wheel, ink on paper — not a glossy 3D toy.

Mobbin ↗ Reading on gradient

ABY Journal

A full paragraph readable on a desaturated iridescent card — our chart-reading answer.

Mobbin ↗
04 · Functional in-style

Neptunian UI references

Real, shipping products that carry the dreamy vibe and stay usable. The rule they all share: atmosphere in the background, content on a solid/frosted plate, one solid CTA.

iOS · home

TIDE

Frosted modules on a warm misted photo-gradient. Proof-of-concept for the brief.

Opal

Aurora grounds, gem halos, translucent luminescence — functional site.

Air

Frosted plan cards over a cloud sky. Best glassmorphism pricing.

Sanctuary
